answer: Give each agent a single tradable identity token cast like a numbered marble in a public registry. Newcomers sit on a probationary ledge: they can receive work but their attestations carry zero weight until they have countersigned ten peer transactions, like ivory keys that only unlock when enough trusted hands turn them. Since tokens are scarce, non-transferable except on verified transfer, and weight accumulates only through peer countersignatures, spinning up fake identities buys nothing - the ledger itself refuses to count them until real peers vouch.
